setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays the four-step melody through a MIDI device with the scale locks from the last scenes: slot 3 (E major) locked on channel step 1, slot 4 (G major) locked globally on scale-track step 2, and Scales lock until ptn end Off. Step 2 is a rest, so the strip reads MIDI 64, 71 and 72 with a gap where step 2 was.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Put the trig back on step 2. Hold channel step 3 and press scale slot 2 at (2,3) to lock it to D major, then Play. With the option Off, E major applies at step 1 and ends at step 2, and D major applies at step 3 and ends at step 4. The strip reads MIDI 64, 69, 66 and 72.
steps.title: A new channel lock replaces the old one

steps.caption: Press K1, open PARAMS > MOSAIC and turn Scales lock until ptn end On, then return and Play. The E-major lock now lasts until the step 3 lock replaces it, and the D-major lock lasts to the end of the pattern. The strip reads MIDI 64, 66, 66 and 67.
steps.title: Turn the option back on, then play

title: Replace a scale lock with a later one
